tooltip.dealt_force_skills.hvk_advanced_: “钻石？哈基姆，你从哪捡的？”
“嗷..哦哦，哈——哈——，然后呢？”
“嗯，哎，给我，我来！哈——哈——”
“哈——哈——哈—哈—，怎么样？”
“散的好快!是真的，纯真的，毫无争议的真！这这...诶”
“*一阵电话铃声响起”
“哎等一下，老大电话”“卡里姆，哈基姆在你旁边吗？”
“哦，在的，头，什么事？”
“你们两个，去金库门口报道，雷斯现在要借调咱们的人手，去围堵偷宝贝的哈夫克毛贼，你们熟悉地形，去给他的人带个路”
“居然要给雷斯干活，这老混账前段时间刚坑过咱们”
“哎呀，重点是这个吗？重点是你小子有救了！你捡到的这颗钻石，肯定是那两个哈夫克的贼偷偷藏的”
“我看到一只渡鸦鸟停在一个土堆上，喊着：‘挖宝藏，挖宝藏’，就顺手挖了一下，就发现了这么个玩意，它...值钱吗？我以为酒瓶底子呢”
“咱逮住他们！连钻石一起交给雷斯，不光洗脱嫌疑，还是大功一件！雷斯一上头，给奖赏向来慷慨的吓人！”
“哦~~要是能立这个功...”“这辈子有啦！”
“这辈子有啦！”
“诶，看地图，按照他们说的，那两个家伙如果想撤，肯定得走这两条路，可是现在这个戒严程度，他们不可能撤得出去。所以，应该在这段路上找个地方藏起来”
“嗯...在这段路如果想找个可以藏人的地方的话...”
“那一定是这啦！”
“心有灵犀——”
“哎，抄家伙，咱必须赶在雷斯的人之前逮住他们！”
“哎呀别哈了，赶紧走！”
“他不是值不值钱的问题，这东西..就这一枚，把你家整个村子买下来十遍都绰绰有余了！”
“啊....?哦.....!这东西，就是雷斯司令丢了的那个什么...呃...非洲之星！那咱们还是赶紧还到仓库去”
“然后让雷斯觉得是你偷的？现在仓库已经封死了，里面全是那什么气体，你总不能拿着它去跟雷斯说：‘哎呦，雷斯大人，这谁把这么大个钻石放我胸挂里了’”
“那...这....呃....怎么办呢，完了完了...这要是被搜出来....卡里姆，你说，既然这东西这么值钱，咱俩有没有可能...把它偷偷卖掉?”
“卖掉？！那你可得想好，一会雷斯肯定要掘地三尺的找，这要是被搜出来，你这辈子就没了！不过...要真能卖出去，那这辈子就有了！”
“啊~~这辈子有了！”
“嗯....诶等下，这东西能让你捡到，说不定是个假的呢！诶，你对它哈个气，看看真假”
tooltip.dealt_force_skills.hvk_brain_uni: Use on an activated vanilla beacon to summon the Beacon boss.
tooltip.dealt_force_skills.hvk_construct: Boss, where did you get this thing? That's insane.

.....Lao Sai, you really should read more. Let me check its functions.... 'built-in general mechanical crafting section and... injection section?' What is the injection section.... Anyway, this thing can handle almost all common recipes, including crafting table, smelting, brewing, smithing, crushing, pressing, kinetic crafting, and whatever altar manufacturing and curse infusion are.
It means its storage reading may not be very responsive, and crafting may have some losses or information loss... Give me a complete one someday and I will take another look.
No idea. They said something about handing off a half-finished product. I saw Havoc people involved and stopped it.
What does this thing do? Rahal, come take a look.
Looks like some tech Hudson has been working on. Roughly, you input a target recipe, and if there are enough materials it can craft up from the bottom to that target?
Then... what did they mean by... half-finished?

Let me see... it seems compatible with many logistics systems. What... storage? Terminals? Wait, even dimensional storage can connect. But it does not look very accurate, and it often reads materials incorrectly....
How do you know that? It just looks like a black box with a big headshot stuck on it.
There are logs. I can read what the developers wrote.
Logs? What are those? Can you eat them?
tooltip.dealt_force_skills.hvk_disassemb: Boss, where did you get this one? That's insane.
Less talk, Rahal. I brought back what you wanted. Is this it? The headshot changed too. Did Havoc finish it?
Not sure. Let me see. Hmm... they are not the same thing, but their operating logic is similar. The function is the opposite.
Speak plainly. I did not understand you last time either.
Simply put, the last one turns materials into products. This one turns products into materials, and it reads storage and recipes the same way.
How do you know this time?
Still the logs. You really did not remember last time, Lao Sai.
Enough talk. Can this thing be used now?
It seems to be a prototype. The core functions are mostly ready and should work. It may be upgraded later, and that will still depend on you.
